chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from al-Thumālī, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh, who said:
If a man strikes another man with a whip, Allah will strike him with a whip of fire.

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who judges and punishes wrongdoing
key_terms.سَوْطًا: a whip; an instrument of striking
key_terms.ضَرَبَ رَجُلًا: struck a man; physical assault against another person
key_terms.مِنَ النَّارِ: of fire; indicating punishment in the hereafter

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about striking another person unjustly?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against physically harming another person and presents such aggression as a grave moral offense. It emphasizes divine punishment in the hereafter for unjust violence, underscoring the sanctity of people's bodily rights.
